fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestRunStatusSpawned shows rhiza run status and --json listing two children of one step with role, leaf, model, state, outcome and session ID, a running child marked running, and a failed child with its reason, and rhiza session show accepting a child's session ID; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestSpawnedSessionOpenResume shows, with a fake Rex and a fake agent, rhiza session pane reading a running child's terminal by its session ID and rhiza session message reaching that running child, and an ended child resumed in the same conversation (same session ID) through the Runner's hand-back resume path from run-handback; go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestRunDetailSpawned shows the web run page listing the same children under their step, the leaf named by its statement, with no session, run or node ID on the page. Touches internal/api/run.go (RunInfo), internal/run/status.go, internal/web/rundetail.go and its template under internal/web/templates; the describe-golden testscript is regenerated with -update.
fields.statement: rhiza run status, its --json and the web run page list every spawned session under the step that spawned it, with its role, leaf, model, state and outcome, and open or resume it like any other session.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestHandbackDeliver shows handback.md written in the run directory with the cause, a red gate step's hand-back writing handback.md naming the failing command and the path of its kept output file, a red ship-check step's hand-back writing the ship check cause, a live session messaged with the handback text, an ended session resumed with the same session ID, and a session that cannot be resumed failing the step with a message naming the session; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-handback shows, with a fake agent, a command step failing twice, its agent step's session handed back each time with handback.md naming the failing command, and the run then passing. Touches internal/api/run.go (a Runner hand-back method), internal/run/engine.go, internal/api/session_message.go, the contract change set's handback.md writer (a cause argument only) and cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/run-handback.txtar; it writes no handback text of its own.
fields.statement: When a run hands back to an agent step, it passes the routing step's cause to the contract change set's handback.md writer, extending that writer to take it: for a gate or command step, the failing command and the path of its kept output from the step's detail; for any other routing step, the cause from rhiza ship check --json as the writer reads it today. It then sends that step's session the handback text the contract change set's agent-invoke-template defines: a live session is messaged as rhiza session message does, an ended session is resumed in the same conversation through its adapter, and the run then waits on that session as on the step's first pass.
